concept: IAM: cross-account role for a third party with External ID
tests: How to securely give a third-party vendor (another AWS account) access to S3 so that only the intended account can assume the role.
expected: IAM role with a trust policy whose principal is the vendor's account, + an sts:ExternalId condition (confused deputy protection). Triggers: "third-party vendor", "assume the role from their own account", "MOST secure".
why_not: IAM user access keys sent by email are long-lived secrets; a public bucket exposes data to everyone; ACLs can't control assume role for cross-account IAM users.
